topic: Data display and role access issues
summary_markdown: The discussion covered two main points: data visibility for campaigns and accessing specific analytics pages. Regarding campaign data, it was agreed that adding the missing data is preferable to displaying 'no data' placeholders. For access issues, [p2] reported being unable to view the 'mall analytics' page due to a required 'mall' role. [p1] clarified that two different organizational accounts exist; the first account lacked mall-related roles, leading to its removal. [p1] instructed [p2] to sync their repository with the latest changes.
decisions: Missing campaign data will be added rather than displaying 'no data' placeholders.
action_items: [p2] needs to sync their repository with the latest changes.
